description:
Claim a confirmed BTC L1 deposit into the Spark Lightning wallet. Call this AFTER lightning_fund_from_btc and after the on-chain transaction has 3 confirmations. Fetches a signed quote from the SSP, submits the claim, and returns the credited sats + Spark transfer id. Requires an unlocked Lightning wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

outputIndex.description: Vout index of the deposit output (default: SSP auto-detects)

transactionId.description: Bitcoin txid of the deposit transaction

name: lightning_claim_deposit
